name: TrendBreakout
description: The bot's strategy: 4h trend following on BTC ETH SOL XRP DOGE, one account, up to 5 open trades. Long when a bar closes above the 20-bar channel (Short: below) and on the EMA200 side; stop 2 × ATR(20); exit when a bar closes through the 10-bar channel. Risk 0.25% per trade, fixed 5× leverage, 0.08% cost per side (fee + slippage). freqtrade 5 coins 04/2020–09/2026: PF 1.55, ~20%/yr, max DD 11%. Run it with Portfolio to match the bot.
